name: New Relic
summary: Send Ogun metrics to the New Relic Metric API and events to the Log API, in the US or EU data center, authenticated with an Api-Key header.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: Ingest key
fields.help: Sent as the Api-Key header. Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

egress.note: The US data center uses the first two hosts, the EU data center the last two.

notes: Metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events, sent as log records: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
